heading.title: Finality and enforcement of arbitral awards

article.title: Finality of arbitral awards.
article.content: Subject to this Part an arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties and persons claiming under them respectively.
article.html:

Section 35 · Part I · Chapter VIII · page 25 of the Act
